note: Mutual Recognition Arrangement (MRA) treating Japan's JCM and Indonesia's GHG Emission Reduction Certification (SPEI) system as equivalent, building on the 2013 Japan–Indonesia JCM bilateral cooperation document. Described by Indonesia's government as the world's first bilateral collaboration model under Article 6.2. In effect until 31 Dec 2030.
source_label: Japan Ministry of the Environment — Press Release on the Japan–Indonesia Mutual Recognition Arrangement

note: Lets Indonesian carbon credits count toward Singapore's climate targets under Article 6; part of Singapore's wider push (11 Implementation Agreements signed as of Jun 2026).
source_label: carboncredits.com — Singapore and Indonesia Seal Landmark Carbon Credit Deal

note: MOU on implementing Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, signed in Singapore by Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs and South Korea's Trade Minister on the sidelines of an IPEF ministerial meeting. Encourages joint emission-reduction projects in Indonesia, resembling Indonesia's existing JCM arrangements; both countries would receive ITMOs from selected projects.
source_label: Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs of Indonesia — Implementasikan Artikel 6 Perjanjian Paris, Indonesia dan Korea Selatan Sepakati Kerja Sama Penurunan Emisi Karbon

note: Mutual Expression of Interest signed at COP30 (PLN + GGGI, witnessed by both countries' ministers) targeting 12M tCO2e from grid-connected renewable energy projects — not blue carbon-specific. A full Mitigation Outcome Purchase Agreement was targeted for completion by end of 2025; not confirmed finalized as of this update.
source_label: Carbon Pulse — Indonesia and Norway sign Article 6.2 deal for renewable energy credits

note: Formal update to the Japan–Vietnam Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM) so verified credits qualify as ITMOs under Article 6; partnership runs to 2030 with automatic 5-year extension.
source_label: green.earth — Japan and Vietnam upgrade JCM to meet Article 6 rules

note: Implementation Agreement signed Sep 2025; Vietnam's government approved it domestically via Resolution 235/NQ-CP, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs completing external procedures for entry into force.
source_label: Nhan Dan — Viet Nam approves carbon credit pact with Singapore under Paris Agreement

note: Bilateral Article 6 implementing agreement between the Swiss Federal Council and the Government of Chile. Previously listed in this dataset as "Feb 2024", which no secondary source confirms — corrected here to match the date on the agreement itself.
source_label: KliK Foundation — Chile partner country page

note: Bilateral agreement on climate cooperation between the Swedish Energy Agency and Ghana's Ministry of Environment, regulating transfers of emission reduction/removal units — described by the Swedish Energy Agency as Sweden's first legally binding agreement on emissions trading under the Paris Agreement. Builds on a 2021 MOU between the two countries. Status corrected here from "In Progress" since the agreement itself is signed and in force (project-level activity under it may still be developing).
source_label: Swedish Energy Agency — Sweden's first legally binding agreement on emissions trading under the Paris Agreement
